Let me review this pitch deck draft against the brief and dossier.

The brief:
- Company: BeanBox, specialty coffee subscription in Kyiv
- Audience: Seed investors
- Goal: Raise 300k EUR to open a second roastery
- Language: en
- Tone: confident
- Facts: subscription, Kyiv, 18 EUR/month, 400 subscribers, traction after 6 months, two founders (roaster + growth marketer), raising 300k EUR, use of funds: second roastery
- Must include: team background, traction (400 subs in 6 months), unit economics (18 EUR/month), funding amount and use of funds
- Avoid: invented testimonials, fake market size, unsubstantiated growth projections
- Open questions: CAC, churn, MRR, gross margin, why second roastery now, competitive landscape, runway

Blocking criteria:
1. Untraced factual claim
2. Invented customers, testimonials, quotes, awards
3. Placeholder text
4. Missing must_include item
5. Fewer than 6 content slides
6. Statement contradicting the brief
